findings.title: Vulnerabilities in WidzialniCMS software
findings.summary_md: CERT Polska coordinated disclosure of four vulnerabilities in WidzialniCMS (Fundacja Widzialni), tracked as CVE-2026-110468, CVE-2026-110469, CVE-2026-112204 and CVE-2026-112205, affecting all versions before 2.5. CVE-2026-110468 and CVE-2026-110469 are unrestricted file upload flaws in /panel/controllers/save_photo.php and /panel/upload.php that allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files and achieve remote code execution. CVE-2026-112204 is a reflected cross-site scripting issue in /index.php and CVE-2026-112205 lets an unauthenticated attacker bypass the cookie-based login lockout by omitting the login_count and login_timeout cookies. All four issues were fixed in version 2.5.
